title: CI jobs near their time caps (checks-merge-install, checks-windows-rest) finish inside them, so no main run is cancelled
why: checks-merge-install hit its 30-minute cap and main's push run 43164094808 on f024eae4e was cancelled, so the merge tool reads main as UNKNOWN and every merge waits.
note: Stability fix. Lane started 01:01 CST Nov 12. Batch runner 10 re-runs the main run once meanwhile. Related: step ci-job-caps-line-count. Part landed: PR #2634 raised the checks-merge-install cap from 30 to 75 minutes, in batch 94 (7e7cd97a4, by 02:39 CST Nov 12). Widened (coordinator 02:39 CST): the same lane now takes checks-windows-rest, which runs 32 minutes of its 37-minute cap. The step stays open until that lands.
